limitations: Visible high-contrast proxies exclude low-contrast realism.
Reused heldout image postprocessing is not new-renderer/geometry/real-factory validation.
Inpaint artifacts prevent causal defect-only learning conclusions; zero detections does not rule out every shortcut.
Window/image Wilson intervals do not account for shared virtual families or paired nuisance seeds as independent physical equipment/products.
Nuisance classifiers at chance do not prove bias-free inputs.
